row.notes: TeamSelect onUpdate (vtable slot +0x48, abs ptr 0x14585a6a8). flow state StateDriverCareerContractNegotiationsTeamSelect (name string 0x14585a5b0, vtable 0x14585a660; the same layout as the Intro vtable 0x14585a470, whose slot +0x40 is Career_ContractIntro_OnEnter): the team select step of the Driver Career contract negotiation, entered after ContractNegotiationsDecision when the player's contract ends (before Intro, Update and Outro); it is absent from the start-of-career flow. Returns link. Raised by laneS.
